//: Markup-fidelity fixture for the badge component. NEUTRAL scenarios (framework-agnostic prop bags) + the GOLDEN markup core blesses for each. Scoped to the single `badge` component (pa-badge) that keen `badge/1` and svelte `Badge.svelte` render — NOT the sibling pa-label / pa-composite-badge / pa-badge-group components in badges.html, nor the pa-badge__remove element owned by another component. Wrapper dumpers map `props` to their own API, render, and the core comparator diffs their output against `golden` after normalization. See ../README.md and button.json/card.json for the model.

propsVocabulary.variant: colour variant (primary|secondary|success|warning|danger|info|light|dark) — the 8 btn-style colour pairs
propsVocabulary.themeColor: 1..9 theme colour slot — emits pa-badge--color-N (paints --pc-color-N + contrasting text); overrides variant
propsVocabulary.icon: glyph/text rendered inside pa-badge__icon before the label
propsVocabulary.label: inner text content

goldenConventions: Structural only — badges add no attribute conventions like button's type. The badge is a plain <span>; a variant modifier is present when a variant/themeColor is set. Slot content is a plain text token (Verified/Status/etc.) so the diff checks the wrapper's structural nesting, not rich content. Attribute + class-token order and whitespace are normalized away by the comparator, so goldens are written for readability. themeColor scenarios deliberately omit `variant` — pa-badge--color-N is the sole colour class and must NOT co-exist with pa-badge--primary (keen's variant defaults to primary; the map + component must suppress it when theme_color is set).

features.//: Feature→class contract authored from dist/css/main.css (NOT components.json — its static extraction misses SCSS-@each-generated variants like the color-1..9 + variant loops). `produces` is a class template with {value} placeholders; capability.mjs expands it and cross-checks against main.css AND each wrapper's map + the scenario set. `produces: null` = structural/native (no pa-badge modifier).

cssStateClasses.//: pa-badge--* classes in main.css that are NOT feature-driven props in this slice, so the axis-1 reverse check doesn't read them as an unmapped feature.

deferred.//: pa-badge__* element classes in main.css that the badge COMPONENT does not own, so no badge feature produces them and no badge golden exercises them. Acknowledged out-of-scope (prose, not a fixture ref).
deferred.pa-badge__remove: Foreign element — defined by command-palette under `.pa-command-palette__tokens .pa-badge__remove` (_command-palette.scss), a remove button command-palette places inside its token chips. The badge component (keen badge/1, svelte Badge.svelte) emits no remove affordance; this class is the command-palette slice's concern, not badge's.

scenarios.name: theme-color-1
scenarios.note: themeColor omits variant on purpose — pa-badge--color-N is the sole colour class. keen's variant defaults to primary; badge.ex must suppress it when theme_color is set (mirrors keen button).

scenarios.name: combined
scenarios.note: Stacks variant + size + pill + icon slot to exercise the full class ordering + icon nesting together.
